rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a lower-expansion blastocyst and AB-quality concept, but it overstates visibility of a well-defined ICM pole and introduces uncertain stage interpretation details from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, semen quality, first-cycle status, BMI, and especially endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Generally structured and logical, but there are notable issues: confusion around Gardner expansion staging, strong conclusions from limited image certainty, and somewhat overconfident attribution of reduced success to lifestyle factors and thin lining synergy.

Broadly evidence-aware on embryo grading, SET, and concern for thin endometrium, but several recommendations (routine freeze-all at 6 mm, sildenafil/G-CSF/aspirin/pentoxifylline, CD138 workup) go beyond standard guideline-supported practice.
Provides clear next-step options for fresh transfer versus freeze-all, endometrial optimization, and future planning, though some suggested adjuncts are not strongly evidence-based.
